required_constraints: stable IDs are globally unique within a baseline
versions are explicit for governed elements
physical quantities reference a compatible unit
physical and RBE-weighted dose are not implicitly interchangeable

languages.name: nltps.governance
required_constraints: normative requirements contain shall
TraceLink relation constrains source and target concepts
RiskControl MITIGATES Hazard is permitted
Hazard MITIGATES VerificationCase is rejected
derived requirement IDs are deterministic
overrides require rationale and approval state

languages.name: nltps.clinicalintent
owns: professional and operational roles, atomic role capabilities, authorized actors
required_constraints: AI-creatable PlanIntent cannot represent A4 authority
state transitions have explicit source, target, actor, guard, and invalidation effects
release profiles bind intended use and commissioned scope
patient PlanIntent instances are prohibited from governance models
AuthorizedActor distinguishes human authority from a generated or automated actor

languages.name: nltps.realization

dependencies.why: Raised so ImportedHLR can inherit governance Requirement. The MPS-4 materialization session performs the descriptor mutation; before that checkpoint the module legitimately still carries DEFAULT.

required_constraints: every realized obligation has an accountable owner
every VerificationClaim binds an executable suite or explicit manual evidence record
parent PASS is never inferred from child records
adapter capabilities declare read/write direction, trust zone, destination, and commissioned profile
imported requirement roots are realization-owned persistence, not a transfer of requirement semantics out of governance
every imported requirement root carries deterministic two-part source provenance
imported requirement roots persist in the import model and never in a structure aspect

required_constraints: a projection may contain only concepts owned by itself or an EXTENDS ancestor
semantic-core concepts are referenced through a holder, never contained
each holder carries exactly one scalar reference

materialization_acceptance: all four language modules exist with the exact controlled names
module dependency graph is acyclic and matches this manifest

dependency_kind_policy.EXTENDS: Target concepts are available as superconcepts in this language's structure aspect. Required wherever a concept declares a superconcept from the target.
dependency_kind_policy.DEFAULT: Module dependency for behavior, constraints, and references only. A concept in this language shall not declare a superconcept from a DEFAULT target.
dependency_kind_policy.change_rule: Upgrading DEFAULT to EXTENDS, or downgrading EXTENDS to DEFAULT, is a controlled change to this blueprint. It shall not be made silently in the IDE; the module graph gate compares each kind separately.

semantic_core_containment_whitelist.why: a dose constraint carries its limit; unit and dose basis travel with the number
an evidence profile cites the controlled sources outside the model

semantic_core_containment_rule: A language may declare a superconcept from any transitive EXTENDS ancestor. It may not declare a CHILD whose target concept a different semantic-core language owns unless that pair appears in semantic_core_containment_whitelist. EXTENDS grants inheritance visibility, never containment ownership: nltps.realization extends nltps.governance so ImportedHLR can inherit Requirement, and that must not become permission to contain Hazard, Decision, RiskControl or any other governed state.
